answer: Weakest link is hardware attestation: a Sybil can clone one quartz oscillator's fingerprint. That still fails because identity issuance escrows a bond in a shared vault and binds it to drift measured against ocean-deployed timing beacons; a clone either forks the bond or drifts off-beacon. One spoof buys one identity at full stake, while mass registration requires distinct bonded oscillators, so attack cost scales linearly and stops paying.
